bench.distribution_scope: Median and p90 across six repeat-level means per readout, weighted by readout count across all 24 traces; one full warmup pass per trace.
bench.order: All six permutations of current, fused float32, fused uint8+fp16 across six measured repetitions.
bench.savings_scope: view near+far plus preallocated map encode; update is unchanged. Full allocating NavPolicy::encode is also timed.
bench.view_timing_scope: Direct engine read calls for near/far; View pose/path metadata copied outside timers.
bench.packed_layout: CHW: probability channels 0..6 and validity are uint8=lround(float32*255); relative heights 7,8 are IEEE binary16 casts of identical float32 heights. Vector is fp16.
bench.bytes_per_agent_scope: Network input payload only; excludes world memory grids, temporary scratch, weights and recurrent state.
bench.equality_reference: Real NavPolicy::encode(memory.view()), every channel of both maps at every readout, including warmup. float32 memcmp; uint8 equals lround(reference*255); fp16 bitwise equals (_Float16)reference. Mismatch exits 1.

limitations: Memory traces record actor memory pose, not the separate physical feet position used by the stand Snapshot; replay uses the captured pose Y as encode height reference.
Replay vector uses the first 238 current eye rays; roads/body are Snapshot defaults because memory-cost.bin does not contain them. Scalar step is timed on these reconstructed inputs.
Standalone benchmark follows navpolicy-contract flags. The runner inherits Jolt SIMD/FP flags; both are recorded. Compare current and fused timings within the benchmark.
Fused far readout classifies only forward output rows 50..99. Savings include skipping classification of cells discarded by the HD far input.

Timings use quick because quiet did not gain admission within approximately 30 minutes; competing gq jobs and CPU affinity are recorded. Historical external-helper and new inline-helper runs have different queue load and order; their absolute times are not a controlled comparison.
Generic standalone flags do not enable F16C: GCC implements _Float16 casts with libgcc conversion calls. Packed timings include that conversion cost; no CPU-specific packing optimization is applied.
N=50 with 8 runners and 16-runner profiles were removed from scope by the user.
Replay uses 24 v5 drive trajectories; population uses the HD proxy and historical train pairs. Replay savings are not an end-to-end population speedup measurement.

N=100 x 8 runners was not measured: gq did not admit the 16-thread/10 GiB request within the allowed 3600-second wait; the request was cancelled with exit 75. Full queue status is in population_8_runners.

Saved engine-targets check exited 75 before compilation because of queue availability; the same target was built and self-tested in the admitted one-thread request. The Python checks ran separately and passed 75 tests.
